program.welcome: Players of every skill level are welcome
about: We're a volunteer-run youth football club. Players learn to run, catch, block, and play as a team, starting with flag football.
Coaches teach safe technique from day one. We care about effort, teamwork, and sportsmanship more than the scoreboard.

pillars.title: Safe Technique
pillars.text: Proper form for tackling, blocking, and falling, taught from day one.

pillars.title: Everyone Plays
pillars.text: Every player gets real snaps, every game.

pillars.title: Team First
pillars.text: Eleven players, one goal: work together.

groups.name: Flag
groups.text: No-contact flag football: running, catching, and the basic rules.

groups.name: Juniors
groups.text: Flag or limited-contact play with proper technique and fitted equipment.

groups.name: Seniors
groups.text: Full teams, positions, and game strategy.

groups_intro: Players are grouped by age and weight guidelines so every game is fair and safe. Ask us which divisions are flag and which are tackle this season.

join_steps.title: Ask Us
join_steps.text: Email us with your child's age and any questions. We'll tell you which team fits.

join_steps.title: Try a Practice
join_steps.text: Come watch or join a practice. No commitment, no cost.

join_steps.title: Register
join_steps.text: Fill out the registration, medical, and permission forms before the season starts, and you're on the team.

uniform: Flag players need athletic shoes or rubber cleats, a mouth guard, and a water bottle; we provide jerseys and flags. Tackle players are fitted for a helmet and pads by the club before the first practice.

safety.title: Player Safety
points: Every coach and volunteer completes abuse-prevention training and a background check before working with players.
Two adults are present at every practice and game. No adult is ever alone with a player who isn't their own child.

Coaches learn the signs of a concussion. Any player with a suspected head injury sits out until a health care provider clears them. Contact in practice is limited, and helmets and pads are fitted and checked by trained coaches.
We post photos of players only with written permission from a parent or guardian, and never with a player's full name.

faq.a: No. We teach the basics, and every player gets playing time.

faq.q: When and where do you practice and play?

faq.a: Athletic shoes or rubber cleats, a mouth guard, and a water bottle. For tackle divisions, the club fits each player with a helmet and pads; you may need football pants and a girdle.
Every team needs a few helpers: coaches, team parents, snack and field volunteers. No experience needed, and we'll train you.

faq.q: What happens when the weather is bad?
faq.a: Safety comes first. We stop for lightning and extreme heat, and we email families as soon as a practice or game is canceled.

faq.q: Can we try it before signing up?
faq.a: Yes! Email {email} and we'll invite you to a practice.
